test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two parallel chords on the same side of the centre of a circle are 12 cm and 20 cm long and the radius of the circle is 5√13 cm. What is the distance between the chords?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the first chord = 12 cm

Length of the second chord = 20 cm

Radius of the circle = 5√13 cm

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ed431c5f2b7efda01a6fa2fce18cf2e435451f2093ff8beca5645f5292c8d29.png] 

OB = OD = 5 √13 cm

AB = 12 cm, CD = 20 cm, AM = MB = 12/2 = 6 cm and CN = ND = 20/2 = 10 cm

In Δ MBO

OB2 = MB2 + MO2

⇒ (5 √13)2 = 62 + OM2

⇒ OM2 = 325 – 36 = 289

⇒ OM = √289 = 17

In Δ NDO

OD2 = ND2 + NO2

⇒ (5 √13)2 = 102 + NO2

⇒ ON2 = 325 – 100 = 225

ON = √225 = 15

As we know,

OM = MN + ON

⇒ 17 = MN + 15

⇒ MN = 17 – 15 = 2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
